newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BOURSE RISE CONTINUES WITH HANSA IN LEAD.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE RISE CONTINUES WITH HANSA IN LEAD.

text.p: Early trade on the Tallinn stock exchange saw Hansapank shares maintain their rise with no sign of it stopping yet.
"I can't see any fall in today's trade," one trader said. "I think that Hansa and Hoiu will close higher."
Hansapank was leading trade with 12.8 million kroons to be on a higher spread of 171.50/172.35 kroons.
"There were some sellers around, but the buying interest is by far stronger," one trader said.
Hansa shares in Helsinki also continued their upward climb with a spread of 63.50/64.50 markka compared to yesterday's close of 63.10 markka.
Hoiupank was following Hansapank after an initial drop to rebound to 169.60/171 kroons vs 168.10 kroons.
"Hoiupank should hold around 170 during trade, there is nothing as yet to bring it down," another dealer said.
The free market was again dominated by trade in privatisation vouchers with 3.2 million kroons of the securities traded.
The securities fell from yesterday's record high of 0.43 to 0.37/0.38.20 kroons.
